purpose: Pre-execution diagnosis package only. No diagnostic dataset, allocation result, hard metric, confusion matrix, quality-cost analysis, or error-pattern result has been generated.

fixed_draft_settings.hard_score: P(K=20)+P(K=30)+P(K=50)+P(K=100), aligned by class label rather than column position

required_upstream_artifact_contract.required_population: exactly one approved aggregate OOF record per each of 809 development query IDs
required_fields: aggregate probability mapping keyed by budget label
per-K prefix quality inputs or selected quality outcomes
prohibited_substitutes: repeated fold rows treated as independent query records

OOF_and_absent_class_policy.proposal: Adopt the approved CT2.1 Full-model query-level aggregate OOF record unchanged; do not recompute, refit, renormalize, or fabricate absent-class probabilities in CT2.2.
OOF_and_absent_class_policy.rationale: Diagnosis must inherit a leakage-safe, class-aware upstream estimate and must not add a second unregistered prediction policy.
OOF_and_absent_class_policy.impact: CT2.2 cannot run for any query/configuration whose approved OOF procedure declares the probability vector unavailable.

hard_score_and_AP.proposal: Compute each query's Hard score by summing the approved aggregate probabilities keyed to 20, 30, 50, and 100. Report sklearn `average_precision_score` once on the single 809-query aggregated vector with Hard=1, alongside prevalence as its no-skill reference; do not label it trapezoidal PR-AUC.
hard_score_and_AP.rationale: This follows the protocol's label mapping and avoids the invalid independent-fold-row interpretation.
hard_score_and_AP.impact: AP and uncertainty depend on the approved OOF aggregation and missing-class policy.

discrete_hard_decision_rule.proposal: For the requested precision/recall/F1/confusion matrix, classify a query as predicted Hard if its approved aggregate predicted budget is greater than 10. Do not tune a score threshold.
discrete_hard_decision_rule.rationale: It is the direct binary coarsening of the existing five-level allocation action and matches Hard=1[M*>10] without selecting a threshold from outcomes.
discrete_hard_decision_rule.impact: This rule defines all discrete Hard metrics; a different approved operating rule changes their values and must be recorded before diagnosis.

ordinal_error.proposal: Encode budget levels in their ordered grid positions 0..4 and report predicted-position minus M*-position, plus its absolute value, separately from numeric-K error.
ordinal_error.rationale: Adjacent categorical budget mistakes should be distinguishable from jumps across several ordered levels without implying equal numeric spacing.
ordinal_error.impact: Defines the ordinal allocation-error scale and its summaries.

uncertainty_and_inference.proposal: Treat allocation, hard-detection, and quality-cost outputs as descriptive diagnosis unless a separate inference plan is approved. If uncertainty is approved, use query-level paired/nonparametric bootstrap with fixed count/seed and report rare-class support; do not infer from repeated rows.
uncertainty_and_inference.rationale: CT2.2 is diagnostic and the protocol has not registered a CI/test/multiplicity family for its many related summaries.
uncertainty_and_inference.impact: Prevents post-hoc significance claims and requires a separate approval before CIs or tests are emitted.

error_patterns.proposal: Pre-specify descriptive cross-tabs by M* category, predicted K, and under/exact/over-allocation. Treat feature/pool-signal associations as exploratory descriptive analyses only, with reported subgroup N and no causal interpretation; do not create outcome-selected failure groups.
error_patterns.rationale: These partitions directly correspond to allocation behavior and limit narrative selection after results are observed.
error_patterns.impact: Any additional subgroup, test, or correction family requires amendment before it is used for confirmatory inference.

policy_comparisons.proposal: Do not add a policy-comparison hypothesis in CT2.2. Report only diagnostic quality/cost consequences of the approved Full OOF policy; Gate A, Gate C, and Gate E remain separate procedures.
policy_comparisons.rationale: Prevents diagnosis from being recast as an unregistered acceptance/comparison gate.
policy_comparisons.impact: No controller redesign or CT2.4 activation follows from CT2.2 alone.
